day1_insight: There's been no measurable rain lately, so there's no runoff driving contamination, and strong summer sunlight is helping disinfect the water. The model's main signals right now: onshore wave energy is raising risk — onshore wave energy drives water — and any plume — toward the beach; wave period is raising risk — longer-period swell reaches deeper and can resuspend sediment-bound bacteria; and the lack of recent rain is keeping runoff-driven contamination low. The most recent sample, 3 days ago, was excellent at 5 MPN/100mL.
